eyebrow: One Pod per node — no replicas field
code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: log-agent
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: log-agent
          image: northbridgeretail/log-agent:3.0.0
caption: A new node joining the cluster gets a log-agent Pod automatically — no YAML change needed.

eyebrow: Tracks completions, not a standing count
code:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: catalog-db-migration
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: migrate
          command: ["./migrate", "--up"]
      restartPolicy: Never
  backoffLimit: 3
caption: Runs once, exits, done — reapplying with no changes does nothing useful, unlike a Deployment.
